title: Photography
slide_intent: Teach art directors to choose the degree of familiarity or aspiration an image needs. A profile picture, an object study and a scene of collaboration ask the viewer to relate in different ways.
strategic_value: Slack can keep product avatars personable and workplace photography expansive while retaining a shared tone across both.
demonstration: Three short briefs accompany a collage of portraits, people at work, objects and an interface example. Color, framing and subject matter vary with the use.
practical_value: Decide which brief applies before choosing a shot. Use the avatar examples for close, warm portraits and the lifestyle examples for people situated in a larger working environment.

content_islands.name: Assignment briefs
content_islands.spec: Place the overall spectrum at left, followed by separate paragraphs for Avatars, Still life and Lifestyle. Bold the three labels.

content_islands.name: Photography collage
content_islands.spec: Group the mixed-size examples on the right. Place profile portraits and an interface crop alongside working scenes and carefully arranged still lifes.
